goal: Allow users to delay transaction broadcasts to prevent observers from linking timing to off-chain activity
Provide built-in scheduling and randomized delay for private transaction announcements
reviewability: The author reworked the implementation to address feedback and is waiting on review
agreement: Objections have been addressed, but no reviewers have explicitly supported the concept yet
Addressed objection that nLockTime defeats privacy by switching to a timelock design (vasild)
Clarified that delays require private broadcast and persistent queues can wait for followups (vasild)
Questioned whether delayed broadcast logic belongs in the node rather than in client wallets (ismaelsadeeq)

why: P3 because it adds randomized broadcast delays to mitigate timing-correlation tracking of transaction origin
Origin privacy is valuable, but demand is uncorroborated and queues are currently held only in memory
